Multinational maritime exercise begins in Kochi

Operation Southern Readiness, a multinational maritime security exercise, has commenced at the Southern Naval Command in Kochi. The exercise aims to enhance collaboration among participating nations in maritime security. This initiative underscores the growing importance of international cooperation in safeguarding sea lanes.
